headlines.description: — Matthew Tkachuk recorded his first hat trick as a member of the Florida Panthers as he helped lead his team to a 5-3 win over the Arizona Coyotes on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tkachuk's hat trick lifts Panthers over Coyotes 5-3

name: Carolina Hurricanes at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Artemi Panarin, K’Andre Miller and Filip Chytil scored third-period goals as the New York Rangers rallied to beat Carolina 5-3 on Tuesday night, snapping the Hurricanes’ 11-game winning streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers score 3 in 3rd to stop Hurricanes' win streak at 11

name: Columbus Blue Jackets at Ottawa Senators

headlines.description: — Anton Forsberg made 22 saves for his second NHL shutout, Tim Stutzle had a goal and an assist and the Ottawa Senators beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 4-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Forsberg makes 22 saves, Senators beat Blue Jackets 4-0

name: St. Louis Blues at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Brayden Schenn scored on the power play and again in the shootout to give the St. Louis Blues a 6-5 victory over the Toronto Maple Leafs on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brayden Schenn lifts Blues past Maple Leafs, 6-5 in SO

headlines.description: — Damar Hamlin was forefront in the minds of the Buffalo Sabres from the time they woke up on a game day through the end of their 5-4 overtime victory at the Washington Capitals on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sabres beat Capitals in OT with Bills' Damar Hamlin on mind

headlines.description: — Mattias Ekholm, Tommy Novak and Roman Josi each had a goal and an assist to lead the Nashville Predators to a 6-3 victory over the Montreal Canadiens on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Predators win 6-3, extend Canadiens' losing streak to 6

headlines.description: — Sam Gagner tipped in Ville Heinola's point shot with 5:40 left to help the Winnipeg Jets beat the Calgary Flames 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Gagner breaks late tie, Jets beat Flames 3-2

name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Tampa Bay forward Brandon Hagel has a lot of fond memories of his time in Chicago.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hagel, Killorn help Lightning beat lowly Blackhawks 4-1

headlines.description: — Jaden Schwartz had a goal and two assists as the Seattle Kraken exploded for four consecutive goals in the second period to come away with a 5-2 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kraken sink struggling Oilers 5-2 with offensive outburst

name: Dallas Stars at Los Angeles Kings
New York Islanders at Vancouver Canucks

headlines.description: — Mathew Barzal had a goal and two assists as the New York Islanders beat the struggling Vancouver Canucks 6-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barzal, Pageau send Islanders to 6-2 win over Canucks
